decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions, due to their size, position and the relationship between the adjoining properties, would represent an obtrusive and overbearing development which would harm the living conditions of adjoining occupiers by reason of enclosure and loss of outlook, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The proposed extensions, due to their size, position and appearance, would fail to be secondary to the original proportions of the house, would unbalance the original roofline of the pair of semis, and  would harm the street scene, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines
description: Erection of single-storey rear extension, part first floor side extension and erection of hipped roof to two-storey side extension.
